svg.title: Windgram scenario gallery
svg.desc: Six committed synthetic teaching scenarios rendered by the package, each captioned by the lesson string from the scenario index.

svg.aria-label: Windgram for Synthetic Front Ridge, model front-arrival, 2000-01-01 1p to 10p (Etc/UTC): surface metric strips above a time-height field; derived series, isotherms, shading overlays and winds aloft are drawn over the profile.

Windgram for Synthetic Ridge, model convective-cycle, 2000-01-01 10a to 7p (Etc/UTC): surface metric strips above a time-height field; derived series, isotherms, shading overlays and winds aloft are drawn over the profile.

Windgram for Synthetic Ridge, model ensemble-wide, 2000-01-01 12p to 5p (Etc/UTC): surface metric strips above a time-height field; derived series, isotherms, shading overlays and winds aloft are drawn over the profile.

Windgram for Synthetic Shear Ridge, model shear-through-lift-band, 2000-01-01 12p to 5p (Etc/UTC): surface metric strips above a time-height field; derived series, isotherms, shading overlays and winds aloft are drawn over the profile.

Windgram for Synthetic High Launch, model morning-inversion-erodes, 2000-01-01 12p to 5p (Etc/UTC): surface metric strips above a time-height field; derived series, isotherms, shading overlays and winds aloft are drawn over the profile.

Windgram for Synthetic Cloudy Ridge, model cloud-base-limits-lift, 2000-01-01 12p to 5p (Etc/UTC): surface metric strips above a time-height field; derived series, isotherms, shading overlays and winds aloft are drawn over the profile.
